text:
kevin_se: Hey team — customer (MercuPay) asked for SOC2 re-audit artifacts. They want: SBOM (binary) + transitive deps list, CVE triage summary for high/critical in the last 90 days, patch timelines, proof of KMS key rotations (signed metadata), RBAC change audit for last 6 months, and recent audit logs for token/key issuance. They need it by EOD Friday. Can we assemble? /cc @max_security @oliver_infra @tara_prodsec

max_security: Copy. Do they want a full CVE inventory or just the three IDs they flagged? Also, confirm binary SBOM is acceptable (source vs binary)?

kevin_se: They said binary SBOM is fine. No new NDA required. They flagged three CVEs specifically: CVE-2025-8431, CVE-2026-1122, CVE-2024-9999 — but asked for any high/critical in last 90d too.

oliver_infra: I'll generate SBOM from the prod build using syft. Command I’ll run: `syft packages dir:./release/artifacts -o json > sbom.json`. Will upload to internal S3 and share presigned link. For KMS rotation proof, we have CloudTrail audit entries. Example snippet: ```{"eventTime":"2026-03-05T22:13:01Z","eventName":"UpdateCryptoKeyVersion","requestParameters":{"name":"projects/prod/cryptoKeys/ci-key"}}``` I can export full JSON and sign it.

tara_prodsec: RBAC history: Kubernetes rolebinding edits aren't easy from `kubectl` — better to pull from our audit logs. I’ll run: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_cluster AND protoPayload.methodName:"SetIamPolicy"' --limit 500 --format=json > rbac_audit.json`. I’ll produce a CSV with columns (actor, timestamp, diff).

max_security: Quick triage summary: CVE-2025-8431 — transitive lib `foo` <=1.2.2 vulnerable, fix present in `foo` 1.2.3. Canary scheduled Fri 22:00 UTC, full rollout Sat 01:00 UTC. CVE-2026-1122 — low exploitability, runtime mitigation applied (WAF rule), plan to patch next maintenance window (T+14d). CVE-2024-9999 — fix merged upstream, PR #452 merged, deploy scheduled tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll compile PR links + CI artifacts.

amy_engineering-manager: Owners: @oliver_infra -> SBOM + KMS logs + signing, @tara_prodsec -> RBAC audit + exclusions list, @max_security -> CVE triage doc and remediation evidence. I’ll package the bundle and upload to SOC2 portal.

kevin_se: Customer also asked for a signed attestation that KMS rotation occurred (key-id + rotation timestamp + signature). Can we produce that?

oliver_infra: Yes. I’ll export metadata like: `{"key":"projects/prod/cryptoKeys/ci-key","rotated_at":"2026-03-05T22:13:00Z"}` and sign with our internal signing key: `gpg --armor --output kms_meta.sig --sign kms_meta.json`. I’ll include both the JSON and signature.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: rollout/service/foo 1.2.2 -> 1.2.3 succeeded on 2026-03-07T10:05:12Z (canary 30m, full 1h). Link: https://deploys.internal/rollouts/1078

max_security: I’ll prepare a compact CVE table (columns: cve, severity, affected, fixed_in, pr, deploy_link, mitigation). Will attach PR links + CI logs + deploy link.

kevin_se: Also add `exclusions.csv` listing packages omitted from SBOM and reasons (private package / license). They want that spelled out.

tara_prodsec: Noted. Will add exclusions.csv. Also will redact any customer-identifying data in logs before upload.

amy_engineering-manager: Target: assemble and upload artifacts ZIP by 2026-03-07 18:00 UTC. If anyone is blocked, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

kevin_se: Thanks all — once uploaded I’ll notify the customer and attach the portal link.

max_security: One more thing — should we include a short remediation RACI and a one-page summary for auditors? I can draft a one-pager.

amy_engineering-manager: Yes, please. Keep it to one page with timeline bullets and owner names.

oliver_infra: Uploading SBOM to s3://redwood-compliance/mercupay/2026-03-07/sbom.json (will send presigned link in thread when ready).

deploy-bot: Artifact upload: sbom.json -> s3://redwood-compliance/mercupay/2026-03-07/sbom.json completed at 2026-03-07T12:34:02Z

kevin_se: Great — I’ll hold on messaging customer until package is complete. Thanks everyone.
